pipeline_steps.label: Fetch Memory Context
pipeline_steps.description: Retrieve existing action items, decisions, budgets, and similar past meetings for LLM context

pipeline_steps.label: Summarize
pipeline_steps.description: Generate and store a structured meeting summary

pipeline_steps.label: Analyze
pipeline_steps.description: Analyze topics, sentiment, entities, and follow-ups

pipeline_steps.label: Review & Approve Delivery
pipeline_steps.description: Pause pipeline for user to review transcript, summary, analysis and confirm or change delivery options

pipeline_steps.label: Save to Memory
pipeline_steps.description: Persist meeting to semantic and ephemeral memory

pipeline_steps.label: Deliver via Email
pipeline_steps.description: Send meeting summary, analysis, and attendee data via email (transcript excluded)

pipeline_steps.label: Save to Drive
pipeline_steps.description: Save meeting summary and analysis to Google Drive

pipeline_steps.label: Create Trello Cards
pipeline_steps.description: Create action items as Trello cards

pipeline_hints._fetch_memory_context: Memory context retrieved. Next: Call `transcribe_refine` to clean filler words and redact PII from the transcript, preserving timestamps.
pipeline_hints.transcribe_refine: Refinement complete. Next: Call `transcribe_get_transcript` to retrieve the refined speaker-labeled transcript.
pipeline_hints.transcribe_get_transcript: Transcript retrieved. Next: Call `transcribe_summarize` to generate and store a structured meeting summary.
pipeline_hints.transcribe_get_summary: Summary retrieved (read-only). If you haven't called `transcribe_summarize` yet, call it to generate a new summary. Otherwise continue with the pipeline.
pipeline_hints.transcribe_summarize: Summary stored. Next: Call `transcribe_analyze` to analyze topics, sentiment, entities, and follow-ups.
pipeline_hints.transcribe_analyze: Next: If delivery review is enabled, call `transcribe_approve_delivery` to pause for user review. Otherwise call `transcribe_save_context`.
pipeline_hints.transcribe_approve_delivery: Next: After user approves, call `transcribe_save_context` to persist meeting to semantic and ephemeral memory.
pipeline_hints.transcribe_save_context: Context saved. Next: Call `transcribe_prepare_delivery` to package results for delivery destinations.
pipeline_hints.transcribe_prepare_delivery: Delivery package ready. Next: Call `send_delivery_email` to deliver meeting summary, analysis, and attendee data via email.
pipeline_hints.transcribe_search_attendees: Search completed. Use the results to determine if attendees need registering. If someone attended but isn't in the metadata, consider re-checking. Otherwise continue with the main pipeline.
pipeline_hints.transcribe_list_attendees: Attendee list shown. Use `transcribe_search_attendees` to find specific entries before registering duplicates.
pipeline_hints.transcribe_search_memory: Semantic search returned. Use the context in your summary. Continue with the main pipeline (refine, read, summarize, analyze, persist, deliver).
pipeline_hints.transcribe_query_ephemeral: Ephemeral data retrieved. Use it in your summary. Continue with the main pipeline.
pipeline_hints.transcribe_save_ephemeral: Data saved to ephemeral memory. Continue with the main pipeline.
pipeline_hints.transcribe_upsert_job: Job record updated. Continue with the main pipeline.

event_templates.failed: Processing failed. Notify the user. Error: {{error}}
event_templates.delivery_approved: User approved delivery after review. Resume the pipeline: save_context, prepare_delivery, then deliver via email. Edits made by user: {{edits_summary}}
